verdict.rationale: GA4 provides the Data API for programmatic report queries, with client libraries, filters, pagination, pivot reports, realtime and funnel reporting. It also points users to an official Google Analytics MCP server on GitHub that an agent can use to query the data, and BigQuery export adds a continuously updated SQL path. missing for 10: details of the MCP server's tools and maturity (the docs only say 'try' it), hands-on or independent corroboration of agents answering growth questions through it, and evidence of data freshness beyond the 30-minute realtime window given standard processing latency.
